findings.text: Advisory, as filed (question 2). `reason` repeats `firstLine`'s one-line body instead of calling `firstLine`. The rubric treats duplicated boilerplate as advisory. The round 2 advisories are resolved.

Advisory, as filed. The owner case would fail when the suite runs as root, because it is skipped only on Windows. That is an environment gap, not a test that passes by construction or survives reversion. Both of round 2's defects are resolved: I confirmed `describe("stagedFacts")` at tests/unit/update-report.test.ts:211 and the throwing-build `status` case at tests/integration/update-command.test.ts:279.
Advisory, as filed. The `realpathSync` step in `gather` is still not exercised. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. AC-31 is pinned only through `status`. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed (questions 5 and 6). The test asserts the observable hand-over, not that `handOver` is the function used. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. Temporary folders are not removed. This is fixture hygiene, recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. The root and owner guard is intact after the move. `who` defaults to the real effective user, and no argument or environment variable can supply it.
Advisory, as filed. `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_HANDED` is now read and removed before the guarded look at the machine, so a failing look no longer leaves it for child processes. This is a hardening.

Advisory, as filed (public-api, question 6). `status --json` gains an additive `update` field, and a store error now writes JSON to stdout. It is documented and recorded as deferred, and no field is removed or changed.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `stageBinary` still runs the staged file's `--version` with no root or owner check. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. When the data directory cannot be written, the log gets one entry per turn and nothing caps the repetition. The spec's Limits state it, and it is recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. A hung staged binary can delay a command by up to about 20 s. This is a stated limit, bounded in the code.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `stageBinary` (and so `install`) still runs `--version` with no root or owner check. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). Two writers can collide on the fixed `<target>.new` name. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `spawnCli` does not pass on the preload's `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_UPDATE=off`. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed (question 4). The rollback for a wrong notice is stated but has never been run, and the runbook says so.
Advisory, as filed (question 1). The suite stays offline through the preload and the copied environment, and CI stays offline through `mode()` returning `ci`. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). A plain release on an older line becomes GitHub's latest and moves the notice back. The runbook names the manual correction.
